{{Quote|I wish to commend you on your performance on this mission. Had the Kaarenth Dissension brought its fleet to bear, we would have been doomed. Coruscant has now given priority to this sector for new ships and personnel, and we expect reinforcements within the month. And thanks to you, we should be able to hold off the remaining Imperials until then.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Naren Bluuis]]|<ref name="Counterstrike" />}}
The '''Corva sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the territory of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. A number of its [[Star system/Legends|systems]] were connected by the [[Daranc Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] which ran through the middle of the sector.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

==History==
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[Colonist/Legends|settlement]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], a colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corva]], located in the [[Galaanus system]], was infested by [[clodhopper]]s from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Before the infestation was discovered, the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] pests had devastated the planet's ecosystem, and consumed the majority of the colonists.<ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|defeat]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] gained a significant foothold in the sector, with a [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Naren Bluuis]]. Based on the [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]-[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Nova (New Republic)|''Nova'']], Bluuis kept a close eye over developments in the sector. This included the surfacing of an ancient [[Kashi Mer Dynasty|Kashi Mer]] [[Kashi Mer talisman|relic]] found by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mahk'khar]], which Bluuis dispatched a number of agents to retrieve.<ref name="Relic" />

Bluuis also confronted a growing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] splinter movement that [[Battle of H'ken asteroid belt|assaulted]] his forces in the [[H'ken system/Legends|H'ken system]].<ref name="Relic" /> This movement, known as the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]], strongly advocated [[Alien/Legends|alien]] dominance, proving popular with many of the sector's alien inhabitants. Bluuis dispatched further agents to root out the Dissension's agitators, eventually discovering their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]&mdash;and [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]]&mdash;hidden in the [[Spawn Nebula/Legends|Spawn Nebula]]. Infiltrating the shipyard, the agents managed to [[Mission to the Spawn Nebula|destroy]] it, creating a large shockwave that ruined the amassed fleet.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

The New Republic Corva sector fleet contained the carrier-cruiser ''Nova'' as its [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], a [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] [[RX4 Patrol Ship]] named the [[Instigator (RX4 Patrol Ship)|''Instigator'']], at least one [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]], and numerous other [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Relic" />
